The '''1000 Field Macrobinoculars''' were the standard model of [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] manufactured by [[Ziko/Legends|Ziko]]. As with most macrobinoculars, the 1000 contained an internal readout which provided information on distance and land elevation. It also came with low-light vision mode and could be stored in an impact resistant case. Other variants were produced, including the [[1020/A]], a handheld pair equipped with a long-range [[Audio sensor/Legends|audio pickup]] unit, and a head-strapped model, the [[1125 Heads-Up Macrobinoculars|1125]].<ref name="ROE" />
